messages:
maria: Putting together a one-page field-ready brief for CISOs. Focus: security controls, SLA summary, recommended deploy modes, and a short benchmark callout. Goal: hand to AE for discovery and attach to webinar signup. Draft in Drive: https://drive.redwood/briefs/ciso-onepager-draft

sam: Love it. Can we include a tiny competitor snapshot (2 rows) vs managed vendors on SLA & isolation? keep it tactful.

alex: Suggested benchmark blurb for non-technical readers: 'Optimized hosted configs often show median token latency under 100ms; typical throughput ~100-150 req/s per GPU; cost varies by model and optimizations like caching and quantization.'

jamal: Inbound routing: tag as `ciso-brief`, route to Field AE queue and PM on-call. Add Slack alert to #sales-enterprise. Webinar CTA: https://redwood.ai/events/secure-inference-briefing

eva: Design notes: single-column one-pager, headline + three micro-tiles (Security, SLAs, Deploy Modes). Use mono icon set and 60% grey accents. Need EN/DE/FR text outputs.

maria: SLA copy attempt: 'Enterprise SLA options available. Typical production target: 99.9% uptime. Median token latency in tuned setups: sub-100ms. Dedicated tiers offered for strict isolation and compliance.'

sam: Small wording tweak: avoid absolute promises. maybe 'median token latency: often sub-100ms in tuned setups; production 95th percentile varies by model and profile.'

alex: Add brief resiliency line: 'Automatic fallback to compatible model variants keeps workloads online during capacity events.'

jamal: Draft Intercom rule I plan to push (pseudo):
```
if message.contains("CISO" or "enterprise" or "ciso-brief"):
  add_tag("ciso-brief")
  assign_queue("Field-AE-Enterprise")
  notify_slack("#sales-enterprise", "New CISO brief lead")
```
Please confirm before I deploy.

ops-bot: doc-bot: created revision v0.9 at https://docs.redwood/briefs/ciso-onepager (rev: v0.9)

maria: I'll update phrasing per Sam/Alex and generate PDF + web asset by EOD. Jamal please prep the Intercom rule and Slack mapping.

jamal: Confirmed. Will test rule on staging and deploy by 5pm PT. :thumbsup:

eva: Design deliverables checklist: PDF @2x, accessible alt text, 3 translations, CTA button that links to webinar, micro-benchmark footnote with non-sensitive numbers.

maria: Suggested outbound subject for SDRs: 'Secure inference brief for compliance-led teams — 2 min read'

sam: Email preview: 'How Redwood meets SLAs and supports private deployments.'

maria: Great. Final step: I'll attach the PDF and update the Drive link when ready. Thanks everyone!
